about_short_description.short_description: Certainly Health is a healthcare marketplace for insured patients to compare guaranteed out-of-pocket costs across doctors.

product.name: Certainly Health Healthcare Marketplace
product.description: An online platform that allows insured patients to compare guaranteed out-of-pocket costs for medical and cosmetic procedures across various healthcare providers.

identifier.value: Price Transparency and Guaranteed Pricing Service

product.name: Price Transparency and Guaranteed Pricing Service
product.description: A service that provides patients with upfront, guaranteed pricing for medical and cosmetic procedures based on their specific insurance information.

product.name: Provider Directory and Appointment Booking
product.description: An online directory of healthcare providers across multiple specialties with the ability to book appointments directly through the platform.

identifier.value: Cosmetic Procedure Pricing and Booking Service

product.name: Cosmetic Procedure Pricing and Booking Service
product.description: A specialized service within the platform that enables patients to compare prices and book cosmetic procedures with upfront cost guarantees.
